title: Adopt Exemplar First Codex Collaboration
summary: Subjective visual and generated-output work separates diagnosis from implementation, declares preservation and rollback boundaries, perfects one canonical exemplar before generalization, and batches low-impact grill-me decisions.

sourceRefs.summary: Enforceable repository rules for mode boundaries, exemplar checkpoints, rollback scope, and visual run contracts.
Human-readable rationale and the accepted exemplar-first collaboration sequence.
Short reusable prompts for diagnosis, exemplar work, grill-me sessions, long loops, and non-global formalization.
